Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of FinTechCo requirements:
- SSO: SAML 2.0 / Okta with SCIM provisioning preferred
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM backing preferred for key custody
- Logging: long-term retention (3-7 years) and export to Splunk/SIEM; retention and egress controls matter
- Network: strict egress restrictions and VPC peering/private endpoints likely required
- Compliance: SOC 2 + financial services controls in scope

Initial thoughts (high level): Hosted API is easiest to get started but typically cannot meet strict VPC+BYOK+HSM requirements. Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) can cover many operational/isolation needs and support customer-managed envelope encryption. For full HSM-backed BYOK and network-level restrictions, Private (VPC or on-prem) is usually the recommended path.

Questions we still have to confirm:
1) Do you require HSM-backed KMS for all keys, or would envelope encryption where Redwood holds an intermediate key be acceptable?
2) Do you have a preferred KMS provider (AWS KMS + CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault with HSM, on-prem HSM)?
3) Do you have minimum retention or export cadence for logs (daily, weekly)? Any legal hold requirements?
4) Estimated peak QPS / throughput and model sizes you plan to serve (helps sizing Dedicated pools).

Next steps: I'd like to bring in our solutions lead (Marissa) and security engineer (Marcus) for a technical deep-dive to confirm feasibility and sketch a mutual action plan. Proposed times: Wed 2/17 10:00am PT or Thu 2/18 11:00am PT.

Attaching: redwood-deployment-matrix.pdf (matrix of Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your availability.

Best,
Dylan

Hi Sarah / James — thanks for the clear requirements and for locking in Wed 2/17 10am PT. Quick answers and next steps from our side so the call can be focused: 

1) Hosted API: not recommended for your security posture. Hosted cannot meet HSM-backed BYOK nor strict VPC egress controls. Good for PoC or low-sensitivity use but not for regulated financial workloads.

2) Dedicated capacity: can support customer-managed keys via envelope encryption (you bring the Customer Master Key in your KMS; we support integrating with your KMS to unwrap per-request keys). Dedicated does not natively provide HSM-backed key custody inside our infra unless we run in a Private deployment that integrates CloudHSM or customer HSM. For many customers, Dedicated + strong envelope encryption meets most controls with lower cost than Private.

Marcus (security engineer) adds: 
- Marcus: We can integrate with AWS KMS using grant/unlock flows and support CloudHSM-backed CMKs if the deployment is Private (VPC or on-prem). If FinTechCo requires the HSM to be under their control in their VPC, Private is the right path.
- Marcus: For logs, we support pushing audit/log streams to customer S3 or to a customer-managed Splunk endpoint; retention is controlled by your side. For strict retention and legal hold, archiving to your S3 vault is the simplest route.

3) Network & egress: Private supports VPC peering, private endpoints, and strict egress ACLs. Dedicated offers stronger network isolation than Hosted but still requires cloud routing arrangements; depending on your cloud architecture we can design peering or private link.

4) Ballpark cost delta (very high level): Dedicated generally runs ~30-60% above Hosted for the same throughput (due to reserved GPU capacity). Private involves additional engineering and infra costs - plan for a material uplift (100%+ over Hosted in many cases) depending on region, HSM costs, and whether on-prem is required. We'll put more formal ranges in the mutual action plan.

Next steps (for the Wed 2/17 call): 
- Marcus to cover KMS/HSM integration flows and what we need for CloudHSM.
- Marissa to present deployment options and preliminary M.A.P. (mutual action plan) with timeline and cost buckets.
- Dylan to run the procurement and contract questions.

Attaching: redwood-private-deployment-arch.pdf and a draft mutual-action-plan-draft.docx. I'll update the MAP with estimated cost ranges and share before the call.

If anything else is urgent, ping me or Marcus directly. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
